planned_images.learning_goal: Students can see that the string '2+3*4' becomes 6 cards (including eof), that the * subtree (3, 4) is assembled first and hung under the right of +, and that evaluating the tree gives 12 and then 14. The goal is that they can name the root (+), the token count (6), and the return value of term (a tree, not 12).

For three inputs, students can tell what each one produced before it stopped: '2 @ 3' never becomes a card (字句), '2 + * 3' has all its cards but no tree can be built (構文), and '1 / 0' has a tree but no value (評価). They can also see that the column number counts spaces as characters (3文字目 / 5文字目).
